Subject: Request: Short safety-net credits while invoice under procurement review

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the clinical team is excited and we've started the initial pilot. Quick update: procurement flagged a required vendor onboarding questionnaire and the PO that was supposed to clear Friday is now queued for legal review. They estimate another 7–10 business days before the PO is issued.

We're concerned the pilot will lapse before the PO clears. Is there any way Redwood can provide a small short-term credit or pedal-to-the-metal safety-net so the sandbox stays active while procurement finishes their review? We're not asking for a discount — just a temporary credit so our engineers can keep validating the integration.

I've attached the procurement status screenshot and the draft SOW we circulated with the clinical lead.

Attachments: Nimbus_PO_Status.pdf (image/png), Nimbus_SOW_Draft_20270430.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — can loop in Dan (procurement) if helpful.

Best,
Eve Larson
Head of Clinical Programs
Nimbus Health

> Thanks again for the demo last week — the clinical team is excited and we've started the initial pilot. Quick update: procurement flagged a required vendor onboarding questionnaire and the PO that was supposed to clear Friday is now queued for legal review.

We can absolutely help keep the pilot alive. Tentatively I can authorize a short "safety-net" credit to cover usage for up to 7 calendar days or $2,000 USD (whichever comes first) while procurement completes the PO. Two quick asks so I can finalize with finance:

- Can you confirm the expected PO number or the date procurement expects to clear?
- Please confirm you'll sign the SOW (attached) once the PO is approved.

Ben and Marissa — can you please approve a 7-day emergency credit for Nimbus Health up to $2,000 and note the HubSpot deal NB-2027-117? If we need to extend beyond 7 days we'll take a re-check with finance.

I'll hold this provisional offer until I hear back from you, Eve. If procurement prefers a formal approval email from their side, let us know and we'll mirror it.

Best,

Hi Eve / Dan — good news: we've approved a temporary safety-net credit to prevent the pilot from lapsing. Details below.

What we enabled:
- Temporary credit: up to $2,000 USD usage credit
- Window: 7 calendar days starting 2027-05-11 15:00 PDT (we enabled at 3pm PT today)
- Notes: credit covers API/compute usage only; it does not apply to professional services or third-party fees. Any usage beyond $2,000 will be billed per standard terms.

Next steps for Nimbus Health:
1) Confirm expected PO number or final approval date so we can reconcile with finance (please reply to this thread).
2) Sign the attached SOW when procurement/legal clears it. We will apply the credit against the first invoice after PO receipt.
3) If you prefer, I can create a formal DocuSign approval for the credit memo — say the word and I'll send it.

Quick links: HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321 — I've added the credit note there. Draft SOW (for your copy): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nimbus-sow

If procurement needs anything from our side (security questionnaire, vendor form), loop Marissa and we'll prioritize.

Thanks — glad we could keep the pilot going.
